responseText:
You've seen those Rune-carved Gemstones? The ones the Runesinger keeps sending over to the Chief?

I know something about them, something dark. I'm not sure I should share what I know with the others yet, though. See, I have something of a reputation for dark notions as it is, and I don't want any extra contention until I'm sure of my hunch.
